title: Setup: build Spring Boot #51372 (S49) at both pins and run its landed tests
description: Setup job for llm-dlc/loops/spring-boot-merged-pr-links-s01-s50-brief.md, case S49 (spring-projects/spring-boot#51372: Extract a runnable JAR and both library scopes from an executable WAR). In the worktrees $P/worktrees/S49-{fix,parent} (P = ~/.cache/in-the-loop/spring-boot-pr-links-s01-s50), offline (dependencies resolved online beforehand), it builds the jars of build-plugin:spring-boot-gradle-plugin loader:spring-boot-jarmode-tools loader:spring-boot-loader-tools with the Gradle each checkout's wrapper names on JDK 25, runs the landed test classes (BootJarTests (test) BootWarTests (test) ExtractCommandTests (test) IndexedJarStructureTests (test) ) at the fix and those of them that exist at the parent, keeps the jars, SHA256SUMS (jars and every class of the changed production sources) and the runtime and test runtime classpaths of build-plugin:spring-boot-gradle-plugin loader:spring-boot-jarmode-tools loader:spring-boot-loader-tools in $P/artifacts/S49-ROLE, then runs the fix's changed test files on a copy of the parent, where they are expected to fail or not compile, and removes the build trees. Script: $P/scripts/case_job.sh. No claims, no verifier.
expected: every step exits 0: fix and parent BUILD SUCCESSFUL with failures=0 errors=0 for the landed classes; transplant prints TRANSPLANT-FAILS-AS-EXPECTED or TRANSPLANT-DOES-NOT-COMPILE-AS-EXPECTED; clean prints cleaned S49

resources.notes: rerun after the second (project-closure) resolution pass; first run failed in about 5 min on offline misses or the generated-jar check

steps.name: S49 fix: build and landed tests
S49 parent: build and the parent's tests
S49 transplant: the fix's tests on the parent
